extension.name: RSB Shop (Shopify)
extension.author: Raydraws, L.L.C.
extension.description: Features a random product from a Shopify collection with its live name, price and link. Reads the store's public collection feed (no API key), caches it, and falls back to the last good copy or a fixed product.

field.name: images
field.label: Featured products: handle = image
field.description: One per line. Only these products are featured, using your own image (e.g. on black). Leave empty to use every product in the collection with its Shopify photo.
field.default: the-king-afro-style-backpack = images/worlds/bp-king-red.jpg the-king-dreads-style-backpack = images/worlds/bp-king-dreads.jpg the-king-flat-top-style-backpack = images/worlds/bp-king-flattop.jpg faces-backpack = images/worlds/bp-faces.jpg

field.name: headline
field.label: Headline
field.default: Prints, originals, apparel and beats in one cart
